chapter.verse: Tua hun sungin Rome gampi mi khempeuh minkhum ding cih thupiakna khat Caesar Augustus' kiangpan hong tung hi.
Hih pen Syria gam ah Quirinius in gam-uk mangpa a sep khitzawh milip simna a masapen ahi hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh amau' pianna khua tek ah minkhum dingin pai uh hi.
Joseph zong David' suan ahih manin Galilee gam Nazareth khua panin Judea gam Bethlehem a kici David' khuapi ah pai hi.
Zuthawl a piaksa Mary tawh minkhum dingin a paikhawm uh hi a, Mary in naupaai khin hi.
Tua khua ah a taam sungun Mary a nausuah hun hong tung hi.
Tua ciangin Mary a tacil tapasal suak a, naupuan tawh a tun khit ciangin gan ankuang sung khat ah sial hi. A hang pen zinbuk ah amau' ading mun om lo hi.
Tua gam mah ah tuucingte gamgiak uh a, a gante uh zan hunin cing uh hi.
Tua laitak amaute' kiangah Topa' vanmi khat hong kilaak a, a kimkot uhah Topa' minphatna vang taang ahih manin amaute lau mahmah uh hi.
Vanmi in amaute' kiangah, "Lau kei un! A hang pen en un, mi khempeuh' ading nakpi nuamna thu ahi Lungdamna Thu note kong puak hi.
Tuni-in David' khuapi ah Khris Topa ahi Honpa, note' adingin hong suak hi.
Note' ading theihsakna lim hibang hiding hi: Naupuan tawh a kitun, gan ankuang sung khat-a kisial naungek khat na mu ding uh hi," ci hi.
Thakhat thu-in vantung galkap honpi khat tua vanmi tawh hong om uh a, hih bangin Pasian phat uh hi:
"Sangbelna-a om Pasian in minphag ngah henla, leitung ah ama' pahtak mite' sungah nopna lemna om ta hen!"
Vanmite amau' kiangpan vantung ah a ciahkhiat uh ciangin tuucingte khatlekhat kiho uh a, "Bethlehem khua ah pai-in eite' tunga Topa' hong theihsak hih thupiang va en ni," ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute manlangtak pai uh a, Mary leh Joseph leh gan ankuang sunga kisial naungek mu uh hi.
A muh uh ciangin naungek tawh kisai amau' tunga kigen thu gensawn uh hi.
Tuucingte' thugen a za mite khempeuh in lamdang sa uh hi.
Mary ahihleh hih thute khempeuh ciamtehin a lungsim sungah limtak lungngai hi.
Tua ciangin tuucingte ciahkik uh a, amau' kianga kigensa bangin a zak uh thute leh a muh uh thute khempeuh hangin Pasian liansakin phat uh hi.
Ni giat a cinni, vun-atna a san ni ciangin amah pen naubu sungah a kipaai ma-a vanmi' piaksa min ahi, Jesu cih min, kiphuak hi.
Moses' Thukhun dung zui-in amaute' ading kisiansuah hun a tun ciangin Topa' kiangah nau ap dingin Jerusalem ah nau paipih uh hi.
(Hih pen Topa' Thukhun sungah, "Naubu a hong masa tapasal khempeuh Topa' adingin a siangtho kici ding hi," a cihna tungtawn ahi hi).
Tua banah Topa' Thukhun sunga kigen, "gam vakhu kop khat, ahihkeileh inn vakhuno nih," cihna zui-in biakpiakna a bawl ding uh zong ahi hi.
Tu-in Jerusalem ah Simeon a kici, midik, thuzui citak, Israel kihotkhiat ding hun lamenin a ngak mi khat om a, ama' tungah Kha Siangtho om hi.
Topa' kamciamsa Khris mukha lo-in si lo ding cih thu Kha Siangtho in amah a hilhkholhsa ahi hi.
Kha' makaihna tawh biakinnpi ah amah hong pai hi. Thukhun zatngeizia dung zui-in naungek Jesu ap dingin a nulehpa in naungek hong lutpih uh ciangin
Simeon in naungek la-in a ang ah tawi a, hih bangin Pasian phat hi:
"Topa Lianbel aw, tu-in na gensa bangin na silapa nopna lemna tawh hong khahkhia ta in.
A hang pen ka mit tawh nangma' hotkhiatna ka mu khin a,
minam kici khempeuh' mai-a na bawlkholh ahi hi.
Hih pen Gentile mite' tungah kilaakna khuavak leh na minam Israel-te' tungah minphatna khuavak ahi hi."
Naungek tawh kisai hih bangin a kigenna a pa leh a nu in lamdang sa mahmah uh hi.

Tua ciangin Simeon in amaute thupha pia a, Jesu' nu Mary' kiangah, "En in, hih naungek pen Israel mite tampi a kisiat nading leh a thawhkik nading ahi zongin, kinolhna lim a pua ding ahi zongin a kiseh ahi hi.
Tua pen mi tampite' lungsim ngaihsutna hong kilatkhiat nading hi a, namsau khat in nangma' nunna kha hong dawtlet ding hi," ci hi.
Asher beh sungpan Phanuel' tanu, Anna a kici kamsang numei khat om hi. Amah khankum tam ta a, a nungak lai-a a neih a pasal tawh kum sagih a tenkhop khit ciangin
kum sawmgiat-le-li sung a meigong hi a, biakinnpi lawi ngeilo, a sun a zanin antanna leh thungetna tawh Pasian a bia khat ahi hi.
Jesu a ki-ap hunlenai lianin amah zong hong nehphei-in Pasian' tungah lungdam ko a, Jerusalem a kitatkhiat ding hun lamenin a ngak mite khempeuh' kiangah Jesu' thu gen hi.
Topa' Thukhun dung zui-in sepding khempeuh a sep khit uh ciangin amaute Galilee gam, amau' tenna khua Nazareth ah ciah uh hi.
Naupang khanglian toto-in thahat toto a, lungpilna tawh kidim hi. Pasian' maipha zong ama' tungah om hi.
Jesu' nulehpa pen Paisan Pawi siim dingin kum simin Jerusalem pai uh hi.
Jesu khankum sawmlenih a phak ciangin ngeina dung zui-in Jerusalem pai uh hi.
Pawi hun bei-in a ciahkik uh ciangin Jerusalem ah naupang Jesu taamsuak hi. Tua pen a nulehpa in thei lo uh a,
amau bangin a ciahte lakah a om ding mah sa uh hi. Ni khat lam a pai khit uh ciangin a tanaute leh meltheihte lakah Jesu zon kipan uh a,
a muh loh uh ciangin Jerusalem ah kilehkikin Jesu zong uh hi.
Ni thum khit ciangin biakinnpi sungah hilhcian syate lak tu-in thungai thudongin om mu uh hi.
Ama' thugen a za mite khempeuh in thu a theihtelzia leh a thudawnziate lamdang sa mahmah uh hi.

A nulehpa in zong a muh uh ciangin lamdang sa mahmah uh hi. Tua ciangin a nu in, "Ka ta aw, bang hangin hong hici bawl na hi hiam? En in, na pa leh keimah in lunggimna lianpi tawh nang kong zongzong uh hi," ci hi.
Jesu in, "Bang hangin kei hong zong na hi uh hiam? Ka Pa' inn ah ka omding lam thei lo na hi uh hiam?" ci hi.
Ahih hangin a nulehpa in amau' tunga Jesu' thugen tel lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu a nulehpa tawh ciahkhawmin Nazareth tung a, amau' thu ngai-in mang hi. A nu in hih thute khempeuh a lungsim sungah limtak ciamteh hi.
Jesu zong pilna leh pumpi khanglian a, Pasian' maipha leh mite' maipha ngah hi.Baptizepaa John' Nasepna
